    Adaptive Kalman Filter for non-stationary time series using position-velocity model.
    
    State vector [position, velocity] tracks signal dynamics explicitly.
    Predictive nature reduces lag_error while state estimation smooths noise.
    Adaptive noise tuning based on residuals handles non-stationary signals.

        x: Input signal (1D array of real-valued samples)
        window_size: Controls filter responsiveness (affects noise parameters)
    
    Returns:
        y: Filtered output signal with length = len(x) - window_size + 1
